comment: gh commands the broker runs for the workbench. A command is its first two words. `api` is read only (GET, no fields) except for the writes named under api: replying to a review comment and the listed GraphQL mutations. Owners limit -R/--repo, --owner, URLs, search qualifiers (repo:, org:, user:) and api paths; they come from the host (GH_BROKER_OWNERS, set from WORKBENCH_GH_OWNERS), or from owners here. The read only commands under public_reads, and api GETs under repos/, may also name a repository outside the owners that GitHub says is public; writes never may. `pr merge --admin` is refused: merges go through the merge queue. Widening this file is a reviewed change.

api.graphql: queries, plus the mutations listed here
writes: a reply to a pull request review comment (POST .../pulls/N/comments/ID/replies, inline body only)
